messages.text: Welcome back, everyone. Staff sync moves to 9:30 Mondays starting this week.
Noted - I will update the shared calendar invite.
Anniversary lecture series: three speakers confirmed for spring. Holding the hall for the second Thursdays.

Yes. The ramp is to the left of the main steps and the doors open automatically. There is a lift to every public floor.
Conversation closed.
Is there visitor parking at the court?
The staff car park is for permit holders only. The nearest public car park is on Mill Lane, about four minutes' walk.
Conversation closed.
I think I left a green umbrella in the waiting area on Tuesday.
Thank you. I have asked reception to check lost property and will reply here.
I'm interested in volunteering as a magistrate. Where do I start?
Our open evening on 2 December is a good start. You can also book a short call through the link on our outreach page.
Conversation closed.
Is there Wi-Fi for visitors?
Yes, join PMC-Guest and accept the terms on the page that opens. It is for browsing only.
Conversation closed.
Good afternoon, this is the criminal clerk at Achebe Rowe. Could someone in the listing office ring me about the mobile number you hold for one of our cases?
Thank you. I have asked the listing duty officer to call you back this afternoon.
